option: environment.control_jerk:0 disables; positive value enables reference jerk in rad/s3
inputs: Same10Hz synthetic TCP velocity inputs and12 fixed recorded action sequences per variant
cpu_scope: controller includes DLS on each20th tick, bounds, floor FK/Jacobian, QP projection, nonlinear floor check; excludes MuJoCo step and logging; first20 ticks excluded
lag_scope: 0.5/1Hz least-squares fit after2s, q1; includes 10Hz sampling and native plant response
gpu_scope:
Controller-only GPU timings, followed by a fixed-action integration probe.

No PPO/gradient updates or robot I/O. GPU timings include dispatch and device
synchronization, exclude compilation, DLS and physics. Existing GPU work is
recorded and never interrupted.
caveats: Lag is phase delay of simulated joint1 at0.5Hz, not compute latency; two poses averaged.
Replay completion means feasible controller execution, not task or learned-policy success.
Jerk limits concern reference motion, not a guarantee about plant jerk.
GPU timings were sampled concurrently with existing live perception; they are not isolated training-throughput measurements.
One-step jerk bounds do not preserve future feasibility near speed, tracking, position, or floor limits.
